<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-1815-18-34" status="unreviewed">
         <ab xml:space="preserve">dang po <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha cig</rs> na re blo rtse 2 kyi  10b8 rnam pas 'jug pa zhes zer te</ab>
         <ab xml:space="preserve">rtse 2 dus 1 car du 'jug pa yin nam rim can du 'jug pa yin |</ab>
         <ab xml:space="preserve">- dang po ltar na rtog 2 1 car 'jug par thal |</ab>
         <ab xml:space="preserve">- 2 pa ltar na rtse 3 pa'i rnam pa lasogs pa'ang 'byung bas de kun the tsom ma yin par 'gyur ro |</ab>
         <ab xml:space="preserve">des na the tsom gyi tha snyad du mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid ni mtha' 1 tu ma nges par zhen pa 1 yin |</ab>
         <ab xml:space="preserve">zhen ces pas rtog med thams cad sel </ab>
         <ab xml:space="preserve">ma nges pa par <lb n="10b9"/> zhen pas rtog pa nges pa rnams kyang sel lo |</ab></seg></TEI>
